title: fstest fisch uto fish
features:
Most likely the fastest auto fish for fisch as it is the most optimized and smallest script plus uses optimized variables to become the fastest by a few milliseconds.
Simple auto fish that uses any rod, doesnt auto use bait and etc.
if you want me to expand on this script, like the post and i may make a whole script.
script:
local game = game
local players = game:GetService("Players")
local localPlayer = players.LocalPlayer
local character = localPlayer.Character
local playerGui = localPlayer.PlayerGui
local virtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local runService = game:GetService("RunService")
local replicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local uDim2New = UDim2.new
local rod

runService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    character = localPlayer.Character
    for _,v in character:GetChildren() do
        if string.find(v.Name,"Rod") and v.Name ~= "RodBodyModel" then
            rod = v
            break
        end
    end
    if character and character:FindFirstChild(rod.Name) and rod.values.lure.Value == 0 then
        rod.events.cast:FireServer(100,1)
    elseif character and character:FindFirstChild(rod.Name) and rod.values.bite.Value == true then
        replicatedStorage.events.reelfinished:FireServer(100,false)
    elseif character and character:FindFirstChild(rod.Name) and rod.values.lure.Value > 0 and playerGui:FindFirstChild("shakeui") then
        local buttonposition = playerGui.shakeui.safezone.button.AbsolutePosition
        playerGui.shakeui.safezone.button.Size = uDim2New(5,40,5,40)
        virtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(buttonposition.X + 100,buttonposition.Y + 90,0,true,game,1)
        virtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(buttonposition.X + 100,buttonposition.Y + 90,0,false,game,1)
    end
end)
